description: Media server for audio, video, books, comics, and photos with a sleek interface and robust transcoding capabilities. Almost all modern platforms have clients, including Roku, Android TV, iOS, and Kodi.

promotion.reason: Owner-approved Jellyfin offering. The pinned Runtipi definition lets setup choose a host media folder; a reviewed storage pin keeps settings on the engine's Linux filesystem. Managed-engine proof imported and streamed exact sample audio after install, restart and keep-data reinstall.

data_storage: Docker named volume for settings; a chosen host folder for media
risk_notes: Creates one Docker container and publishes one loopback port on this computer.
Keeps settings in a Docker named volume; keep-data uninstall retains it and deleting data removes it.
Mounts the media folder you choose at setup. Jellyfin can read and write that folder.
Opens a setup wizard to create the first administrator and add a media library.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
LinuxServer packages the image; Jellyfin itself is GPL-2.0.

image_pins.reason: The reviewed Runtipi definition offers LinuxServer Jellyfin 10.11.11; pin an audited 12.0 image from the same registry.
